verdict.rationale: Mollie's refunds docs say refunds can be created through the API endpoint and also manually in the Mollie Web app (dashboard). The idempotency docs confirm partial refunds via the API, warning that a retried request 'may lead to two separate partial refunds'. The Magento refund-manager item is a host-platform feature and is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that partial refunds can be issued from the dashboard, detailed Refunds API reference (amount parameters, full vs partial semantics), independent or hands-on corroboration.
